posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
Most ridiculous victory vs. Omnitron I can imagine.  I was Vis, had Twist the Ether on myself (demoralization) cause our damage was crap early.  Then Realm of Discord plays Imbued Vitality and Omnitron plays Electro-Pulse Explosive.

I Wrest the Mind Electro-Pulse and it goes off start of Omni's turn, with devices taking -1 damage.  Redirecting each shot and reducing damage dealt to myself and it by 1 (TtE) I end up killing Omnitron and the Electro-Pulse Explosive in one go, ending the game with 2 HP (I was missing a bit of health and had decoy out)
